name: data-and-resources-by-camps
notes:
NPM Bangladesh has produced a number of tools based on its regular data collection activities and drone flights.
The package of April 2018 is based on [NPM Baseline 10](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/needs-and-population-monitoring-npm-bangladesh-round-10-site-assessment) (as of 17 April) and NPM drone imagery (as of 24 April).

Here below, the complete package by camp:

- SW Map package
- KMZ file
- Drone image

The full image and shapefiles are available at this [link](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/iom-npm-cox-bazar-uav-imagery).

organization.name: international-organization-for-migration
organization.title: International Organization for Migration (IOM)
organization.description:
IOM is committed to the principle that humane and orderly migration benefits migrants and society.

As the leading international organization for migration, IOM acts with its partners in the international community to: a) Assist in meeting the growing operational challenges of migration management.
b) Advance understanding of migration issues.
Encourage social and economic development through migration.
c) Uphold the human dignity and well-being of migrants.
